text: {"lessons":["My account rose overall despite several monthly declines, but that does not show that gains will continue or that I can predict the next move; past price changes are not a signal.","Judging each stock only by whether it is above or below my own purchase price can distract me from evaluating the portfolio together and making decisions based on the plan, not break-even hopes.","Rarely trading has kept me from reacting to ordinary fluctuations, but I should still review my overall risk and cash periodically and trade only when a deliberate portfolio decision calls for it."]}
